Workflow.Name: Convert Email Body to Plain Text (Child)
Workflow.Description: This flow will accept an email body in HMTL format, and a number of characters. It will Convert HMTL to plain text, remove inline image tags and remove new line characters. It will return a string of the length of characters requested
